misconception_source.label: Treated a marginal percentage as a conditional percentage

sources.note: marginal distributions summarize one variable overall; conditional distributions summarize one variable within levels of another

options.text: Overall, about 47% of all cases are in the 'uses portal' category, so each patient age group group has about 47% in that category.
About 59% of older adults are in the 'uses portal' category, compared with about 40% of younger adults, so older adults have the larger conditional percentage.

misconception_source.label: Used the column total when the condition was the row group

sources.note: conditional distributions must use the denominator for the stated condition, such as the row total when comparing within row groups

options.text: Among cases in the 'uses portal' category, about 57% are younger adults and 43% are older adults, so those are the conditional percentages within the two patient age group groups.

misconception_source.label: Compared raw counts instead of conditional proportions

sources.note: two-way tables are interpreted through marginal and conditional distributions; comparing groups requires matching denominators

options.text: Because the count 50 is larger than 38, younger adults have the larger conditional percentage than older adults.

criteria.description: Selects the row-conditional interpretation that uses each row total as the denominator.
